citations.quote: Its graceful shape, soft luster, and subtle color variation of the glaze interact in perfect unity.
Simplicity and refined elegance are Ru ware's hallmarks.
Other physical characteristics include an ash-grey body, soft greyblue glaze with a fine crackle, as well as small sesame-seed spur marks on the base.
The little black spot in the glaze inside the dish is one of the slight imperfections characteristic of genuine Ru ware.
China, Henan Province, Baofeng, Qingliangsi, Northern Song dynasty (960-1127)
Diameter: 12.8 cm (5 1/16 in.); Overall: 3.8 cm (1 1/2 in.)
Men-chu Wang, Beijing, China. Seller's No. 18
(Frank Caro [1904–1980], New York, NY, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
Valenstein, Suzanne G. A Handbook of Chinese Ceramics. New York: Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1975.
